exposure: timing of Programmed Intermittent Pulse Injection (PIEB) administration
outcome: Number of Patient-Controlled Epidural Analgesia (PCEA) compressions
cohort: 85 patients who received PIEB analgesia during delivery and postpartum rehabilitation nursing
finding: Administering PIEB 60 minutes after analgesia, compared to 90 minutes, resulted in lower pain scores at 1 hour, reduced epidural drug dosages, fewer PCEA compressions, and improved quality of life, without significant differences in other outcomes.
